name: NZ Power Outages
description: Ingests current and planned electricity outages from New Zealand lines companies via the TAK.NZ power outages API and posts them to the map as point features with customer impact, cause and restoration details.

permissions.description: Submits power outage points to CloudTAK

schedule.description: Polls the TAK.NZ power outages API for current and planned outages on a schedule.
